paper_title: A Search for Hidden Sector Photons with ADMX
notes: ADMX light-shining-through-wall (cavity-to-cavity) search for hidden sector photons at 722.725 MHz (photon energy ~2.99 ueV). The paper explicitly states chi > 3.48e-8 excluded at 95% CL for masses near 3 ueV, with lower masses excluded at reduced sensitivity (Fig. 4). Only the 3 ueV anchor value is given numerically in text; the two lower-mass points are estimated from the stated scaling chi ~ (omega/m)^2 G^{-1/2} of Eq. (3) and Fig. 1, so they are approximate. This is not a dark matter haloscope search (no local DM density assumed). The projected upgrade sensitivity chi < 1e-9 is mentioned but the primary result is a measured exclusion. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.7, 3))
